title: PCS (Project Context System) deferred — memory layer is Claude Code auto-memory + .context/changes/ for now
context: Fusion's engineering template calls for PCS, a local-first append-only event log + sqlite index of project activity, to live under .project-memory/. It's not installed on this machine today. The project already has two mechanisms covering the same need from different angles: (1) .context/changes/YYYY-MM-DD.json — append-only, in-repo change log; (2) Claude Code's built-in auto-memory under %USERPROFILE%\.claude\projects — persistent cross-session user/feedback/project/reference memory. Combined they cover 'what happened' and 'what the operator prefers' without PCS being installed.
decision: Defer PCS install. Record the gap here so a future session knows the memory stack is intentional, not accidental. .project-memory/ is pre-ignored in .gitignore so a later install adds the directory without a committed-event-log accident.
scope_in: No code depends on PCS being present. The agent definitions in .claude/agents/ do not reference it.
docs/AI_Assisted_Development_Framework.md names 'record decisions' as a flow step but points at .context/decisions/, not PCS.
scope_out_deferred: Actually installing PCS. Revisit when a cross-session memory need surfaces that the current stack doesn't cover — e.g. 'which features did we start and park?' at a scale that the YAML/JSON change log stops being readable.
Automating the migration from Claude auto-memory into PCS when it lands. Likely a one-time export script when the time comes.
invariants: .context/changes/YYYY-MM-DD.json is the authoritative in-repo change log. Append-only — new entries at the bottom, old entries never edited.
If PCS is installed later, this ADR gets a sibling ADR-00NN flipping its status, not an edit in place.
consequences: Agents do not need to call out to PCS; they read .context/ directly.
